Here I have made a small change to another quote from Marcus Aurelius:\

> But cast away the thirst after social media, that thou mayest not die
> murmuring, but cheerfully, truly, and from thy heart thankful to the
> gods.\

<http://classics.mit.edu/Antoninus/meditations.2.two.html>
